name: docx_edit
description: Create or modify a .docx file via the block format. Blocks can be passed as a string in the `blocks` parameter or via a file path in `blocks_file`.

command.description: Action to perform on the file.

blocks.description: Blocks in text format. Alternative to blocks_file.

blocks_file.description: Path to a file containing blocks. Alternative to blocks.

serialize_output.description: Only for command=serialize: output file path. If omitted — print to stdout.

json_output.description: If true, run with --json and return structured output.
